nits.where: src/pages/StockMind/chartEmptyState.js — the `nothing-in-window` fallback headline (`${stored} ${label} bars are stored for ${who}, but none fall inside the selected dates.`), reached when `coverage.stored > 0` and no `note` arrived; and src/pages/StockMind/PriceChart.jsx line ~1186, which passes `bars: candles.length` into `emptyState`.
nits.problem: The composed fallback is the one sentence left that can be false. Every /ohlcv branch with `stored > 0` sends a non-empty note (matched == 0, and the truncation note), and the success branch sends bars, so the fallback can only fire when the reply DID carry bars and `candles` came out empty — every bar rejected by `toChartTime` or the finite check on open/high/low/close. In that state the bars did fall inside the window, and if master had cleared the dates (`pickRange(null)` sets both to '') there is no window at all to be wrong about. `emptyState` receives `bars: candles.length` only, so it cannot distinguish a reply with no bars from a reply whose bars the renderer discarded. Not reachable from the route as it stands — `pd.to_datetime(errors='coerce')` + `dropna` strips unparseable stamps, both emitted stamp formats parse, and a non-finite price breaks JSON.parse in the bridge into a route-level failure — which is why it is a NIT and not a blocker. Same split makes StockMind's band (gated on `bars.length > 0`) and the overlay (gated on `candles.length === 0`) both appear in that state, doubling the report again.
nits.fix: Pass the raw reply bar count into `emptyState` alongside `candles.length` and give `raw > 0 && drawn === 0` its own kind and sentence ('N bars arrived but none could be drawn'), or at minimum drop the 'inside the selected dates' clause from the composed fallback so it claims only the count. Add an assertion for the new input; the existing 'with no note on the reply' fixture currently exercises an input the route cannot produce.

nits.problem: On the empty-store branch the route's note is rendered nowhere: `nothing-yet` composes its own Section 107 headline and has no field carrying the note, and the message band is now gated on drawn candles. Nothing false is shown — the composed sentence names the interval and the range the note omits, and the fetch button covers the sync=true advice — but the provider-reach clause is lost, and `hint` only substitutes for it on capped intervals: `describeLimit('1d')` returns null, so a daily chart with an empty store shows no equivalent. Section 126's claim that 'the note is never suppressed when the renderer has nothing truer to say' is stronger than what this branch does.
nits.fix: Either use the route's note as the `hint` when `stored === 0` and `describeLimit` returns null, or amend the Section 126 wording to say the empty-store note is deliberately superseded by the more precise composed sentence.
